description.en: A single-page landing site for a curated ex-international iPhone service. Buyers send the model and budget on WhatsApp, and the page lays out the four stages: request, hunting and inspection with 3uTools, a photo and check report before payment, then shipping. Device cards, WhatsApp links, and site data live in one config file, and the build is static through SvelteKit's adapter-static.
description.id: Situs landing satu halaman untuk layanan iPhone eks-inter pilihan. Calon pembeli mengirim seri dan budget lewat WhatsApp, lalu halaman ini menjelaskan empat tahapnya: request unit, pencarian dan pengecekan dengan 3uTools, laporan sebelum bayar, lalu pengiriman. Data unit, tautan WhatsApp, dan data situs disimpan di satu berkas konfigurasi, dan hasil build-nya statis lewat adapter-static SvelteKit.
